newsitem.title: UK: London gold closes up 80 cents ahead of Fed.
newsitem.headline: London gold closes up 80 cents ahead of Fed.

text.p: GOLD - Closes at $381.80/$382.30, up 80 cents from Monday but off highs from short-covering rally. Awaiting U.S. FOMC meeting for decision on interest rate hike after close of Europe market. SILVER - Ends up one cent at $4.88/$4.90, also off highs. PLATINUM - Closes barely changed at $386.10/$387.10, up 10 cents. Down from high bid of $388 an ounce. PALLADIUM - Finishes down 25 cents at $117.00/$118.00.
